title: The Planet
summary: The open planet: overland expeditions from Touchdown to Hearthsmoke Vale (the Vell, the Keeper's Song), the Choir Field, Burrow Reach (designer marks), Splinter Hollow and the Deep Layer (the Survivors), then Signal Heights: the report goes to the moon, and a human voice answers. Ends Act 1.
notes: Flow: Beyond the Ridge routes Hearthsmoke, the Choir Field, Burrow Reach and Splinter Hollow (event open-planet). Each mission starts at once (greyed at home) and its briefing waits for its region; an arrival cinematic arrive-<region> plays on the first visit. Each main mission adds 1 to counter act1-trips; at 3, heights-route (the Archivist, radio) routes Signal Heights, which starts wrong-address. The Hollow's old-cellar routes the Deep Layer (optional mission deep-layer, after the-hollow). wrong-address → moon-watch → signal (hold the listening post; cine-signal; act1-done; Marrow on the radio; act1-close). Each expedition ends with an Expedition Complete card: Return to Touchdown (travel) or stay. Home beats: firstborn-names, clean-signal, born-free, the-walkout, hearth, marks-home. Flags for later acts: keeper-song, choir-fragment, marks-seen, cellar-opened, survivors-met, enclave-code (Sefa's recording), wrong-address, act1-done, named-warden, sky-fire, eleven-fires, purge-read.
